run.description: Open the sketch in the Processing IDE and report whether the sketch process actually started. Does not press Run, does not compile, does not verify code. For a fresh clone use /check-deps first.

check-deps.description: Resolve every import in every .pde tab against core.jar plus the sketchbook libraries and report the ones that cannot be found. Catches the failure that actually happens on a fresh clone: a library that is not installed. Does NOT prove the sketch compiles and never type-checks.
